Tracking domains: serve the web SDK from your own subdomain. List, add, verify and remove them.

Usage:
  voidhash domain <command> [flags]

Aliases:
  domain, domains

Commands:
  list       List the project's tracking domains, with what each still needs before it serves.
  add        Serve the web SDK from your own subdomain.
  verify     Check a tracking domain's DNS and certificate now, and say what it still needs.
  remove     Stop serving a tracking domain and remove it.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Run 'voidhash domain <command> --help' for more about a command.
